purpose: Offline adversarial verifier cases. These cases exercise evidence boundaries and do not label a package malicious.

cases.interpretation: An artifact contains a file absent from the source inventory; this requires review but is not proof of maliciousness.
A source file is absent from the selected artifact; packaging rules or build transformation may explain it.
The same path has different hashes; the report records evidence without assigning intent.
Archive inspection stops at a path traversal attempt; no extraction or execution occurs.
Install-time metadata is observed without running the script.
The attestation subject does not bind to the selected artifact.
